name: something being still
arrivals: Something has arrived and it has arrived by being still.
There is something here now. It came without approaching.
The stillness in the room acquires a shape.
departures: The stillness goes back to being ordinary stillness.
It is elsewhere, being still there.
It has withdrawn, unhurried, and taken the quiet with it.
looks: Still. Extremely still. It is very good at this.
It is not looking at you. It has no obvious front.
It is the size of a person and the shape of a decision.
It has been here longer than you have and did not mind waiting.
